da-non-sequitur.notes: 'The negative eigenvalue λ_min≈-0.956 is the reason the LP has a global minimum at tr_M=0 (massless). The braid group realizability constraint prevents this…' — the jump from an indefinite Gram matrix to 'global minimum at tr_M=0' and then to a length-L coefficient bound O((1+|h|)^L) excluding it is asserted without the intermediate optimization lemma. Plausible but the logical chain is compressed.

da-citation-misuse.notes: -- Ref: [bertsimas1997] for LP strong duality + dual sensitivity (lp_dual_stability.lean:75) is an appropriate source for claims (2) and (4).

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: 'LP-confined' quantifies over sub-braids 'obtained by removing one or more generators from the braid word' — but a braid word has many sub-words and the order/which-removals are not pinned, so 'no proper sub-braid is LP-stable' is ambiguous about the quantifier domain. Also the proton is written both as B_3·uud and B_3=(σ0σ1⁻¹)^3; the generator basis for the hadron vs the sub-unit could be clarified.
